overview.title: A Quieter Layer of the Town’s Story
overview.p1: Essaouira’s Mellah preserves a quieter grain of the city: residential lanes, old doorways and heritage markers of a community that shaped the port’s trading life for generations.
overview.p2: This is not a polished theme attraction. Walk slowly, treat homes as homes, and let a guide unlock history if you want depth.
overview.p3: Pair the Mellah with the ramparts and main medina rather than a long separate outing.
